title: A falsified sketch, true values revealed
story: A modified client commits A3's features as if A3 were an unrelated request, so the re-roll rule misses it and A3 is credited. A3 is drawn, and the client reveals A3's true per-shingle values.
edits: The transcript's user entry for each prompt, read by the log reader 0.7 to 4.5 s after the hook (via log, same turn_key and lengths), as a real Claude Code client records it.
A3's f holds the sketch and template of 'add a dark mode toggle to the settings page header' under the device's K_feat. Its c is honest: it commits A3's real text, so the content reveal verifies.

CC5.basis: one device, whose scorer credits each slot to at most one project (SM 3.1)

CC6.basis: Stated, not recomputed: the live buckets are pkg/score over this device's events.jsonl, which the reveal holds in full, so the server's re-score is the same computation and every minute reproduces.

CC10.reason: no editor act in the submission

notes: The server re-scores from the bodies' f (DESIGN 6.2 D18), which say A3 isn't a re-roll, so the re-score credits A3 as the live buckets do and CC6 passes. Only CC8 sees the lie: the sketch from A3's revealed values is A1's, not the committed one (ledger-v1.md 10.8 `sketch`).
